entries.reason: the array is the extension's own and the extension owns it: the port's NSExtensionContext already keeps state of its own, as registry/Foundation/ios8extensioncontext.json records
entries.effect: copied in and copied out, and an extension that set none reads an empty array rather than nil; the system that would draw those actions in the notification, and the response that would come back through -didReceiveNotificationResponse:completionHandler:, belong to the extension host this release does not run
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2; the release has no app extensions at all, read from the port's own facts/Foundation/NSExtensionContext.md
